_comment: Forthcoming/lost papers Crossref's journal listing AND its batched filter=doi index both miss (validated live: the rescue's batch fetch returned nothing for these; the singular GET is also tried by the rescue first). Each record is merged by mergeSupplement in build-data.mjs, which honours _aia-fixups.json — these three carry volume/issue/pages there, so they land PUBLISHED, not Articles in Advance. Abstracts left empty: the pubsonline needy-abstract harvest fills them. Source: publisher TOCs at pubsonline.informs.org/toc/opre/67/2, /67/4 and /68/2.
